subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result classes may be replaced in model-visible provider payloads to protect prefix cache without breaking normal agent reasoning?
rationale: The code can mechanically summarize results, but choosing whether normal `read`, `exec`, web, or memory outputs are disposable is a product/runtime policy decision with session-state impact.

options.title: Narrow to heartbeat/status only
options.body: Remove normal tools such as `read` and `exec` from the replacement set, then prove the focused heartbeat/status cache mitigation on the current provider surface.

options.title: Design a broader tool-result policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define which tool outputs may be summarized, hidden, truncated, or isolated across providers and sessions.

options.title: Prefer another cache strategy
options.body: Keep this PR open or close it only after a different proof-positive cache fix, such as a provider-specific boundary strategy, lands for the linked regression.

recommendation.title: Narrow to heartbeat/status only
recommendation.body: Remove normal tools such as `read` and `exec` from the replacement set, then prove the focused heartbeat/status cache mitigation on the current provider surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest current-main history on the provider payload conversion paths that would own the policy implementation.
